written.headline: Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
written.summary: Walmart announced that next month shoppers will be able to connect their own AI agents to its website, with controls such as purchase approval and spending limits. The rollout includes an Agent Gateway using the Model Context Protocol and Agent Profiles to separate agent purchases from the user’s own.

written.headline: Google adds conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay in US
written.summary: Google has enabled its Gemini AI assistant in Google Maps for Apple CarPlay, allowing US drivers to converse with the navigation system. The feature lets users ask multi‑step questions and receive directions, with a global rollout planned.

written.headline: Meta pauses Muse conversation‑sharing after security firm finds 6,800 public links
written.summary: Meta has temporarily disabled the Muse feature that lets users share AI conversations via web links after researchers at security firm Claroc discovered over 6,800 publicly accessible links containing sensitive personal and business data. The links were easy to enumerate because the URL structure included the conversation title and a short random ID.

written.headline: OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud
written.summary: OpenAI will roll out its GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models—Astra, Sol and Luna—on Google Cloud, with private‑preview access for select enterprise customers. The models will also be added to Google’s Antigravity coding tool.
